motivation: A public classical baseline identifies movie/frame count calibration as important, and EXP196 finds endpoint-limited FN is the development plurality. Test a parameter-free deployment rule on existing complete graph arms.

parent: EXP190 fixed deployable min8 forward / min3 reverse policy.
policy: For each movie, among every already evaluated EXP190 component-length arm, choose the whole graph minimizing absolute total_node_ratio, i.e. closest predicted count to the provided estimated_number_of_nodes. Exact ties prefer the registered parent arm. No metric value participates in selection.
promotion_gate: Positive pooled delta over EXP190, nonnegative score delta in both embryo directions, and positive lower 95 percent bound from 20,000 direction-stratified paired movie bootstrap draws.
interpretation_guard: This tests whether the coarse count estimate is sufficient for graph selection. Failure rejects exact count matching, not count calibration as a learned or uncertainty-aware research direction.
evidence_class: Sequentially exploratory development OOF; cannot alter EXP192 before an independent confirmation decision.
